short_description: A state SOC misses a low-and-slow password spray that ends in MFA fatigue, lateral movement and DNS exfiltration of taxpayer files. UEBA (an Isolation Forest registered in Unity Catalog) ranks the entities; a Threat Hunting Copilot app on Lakebase runs an agent that pivots across sign-in, VPN, EDR and DNS logs, maps the incident to MITRE ATT&CK, asks the IR playbook (the Genie agent over the documents) for severity, deadlines and containment, and writes the analyst's incident case back; the CISO tracks MTTD/MTTR, alert noise and ATT&CK coverage in an AI/BI dashboard and Genie.
